title: Numbers to 200: Counting, Names and Comparing
seo_title: Grade 2 Numbers to 200 Worksheets with Answers (CAPS Maths)
standard_code: Grade 2: Count forwards and backwards; number symbols and names
standard_text: Count forwards and backwards in 1s, 2s, 5s and 10s from any number between 0 and 200; know number names and symbols to 200; describe, compare and order numbers to 99 and beyond.
meta_desc: Free CAPS Grade 2 maths worksheets: counting to 200, number lines, number names, comparing and ordering numbers. 100 questions with memos.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • After 99 comes 100, then 101, 102 … up to 200.
  • Count in 2s, 5s and 10s by adding the same step each time.
  • To compare, look at the hundreds, then the tens, then the ones.
  • To order, start with the smallest.

Examples

Example

Count on in 10s: 140, 150, …

add 10

Answer: 160

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
At a new hundredAfter 109 comes 110.
Digit places105 is one hundred and five.
Bigger or smallerCompare the hundreds first.
